title: My Flashcards
text:
I have a box of flashcards. Each card has a word on one side. On the other side, there is a picture. I like my cards very much.

I study with my flashcards every day. I read the word and say it out loud. It helps me learn new words. My English is getting better.

questions.text: What is on one side of each card?
How often does the writer study with the flashcards?
How does the writer probably feel about the flashcards?
options: They like them and find them useful
They are bored and never use them

questions.text: Who is the writer most likely to be?
options: A student who is learning English

vocabulary.definition: small cards with information used for studying
all of the days or things in a group, one by one
to get knowledge or skill by studying or practicing

paragraph_translations: Tengo una caja de tarjetas. Cada tarjeta tiene una palabra en un lado. En el otro lado, hay una imagen. Me gustan mucho mis tarjetas.
Estudio con mis tarjetas todos los días. Leo la palabra y la digo en voz alta. Me ayuda a aprender palabras nuevas. Mi inglés está mejorando.
